item.text: {"analysis":"The host run succeeded after replacing fork_rng with an allowed torch.no_grad() context and explicit CPU RNG save/restore. This preserves the shallow branch’s zero initialization without advancing subsequent CPU random draws. Validation HR@10 was 0.645 and NDCG@10 was 0.43189930381953023; the best checkpoint was epoch 20 of 40. No baseline was supplied, so improvement cannot be established.","code_summary":"NextItNet uses 64-dimensional tied item embeddings and eight causal residual blocks with dilations [1,2,4,8] repeated twice. Each block gates between local and dilated convolutions, then applies a second dilated convolution, LayerNorm, GELU, dropout 0.2, and learnable per-channel residual scaling initialized to 0.1. A zero-initialized causal width-5 convolution adds a shallow path from the input embeddings. Padding masks and final LayerNorm precede embedding dot-product scoring. Hyperparameters: maxlen 128, kernel size 3, LR 0.001, weight decay 0.00001, batch size 128."}
